commands.name: install
commands.description: Install dependencies exactly as the lockfile pins them.

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Prettier check. Blocking because a worker can fix it by running the prettier format command.

commands.name: build
commands.description: Compile the published entry points with tsconfig.build.json, so a change that typechecks but does not build is caught before publish.

commands.name: prettier
commands.description: prettier --write over the same files the lint gate checks. Call it before commit_files.
